name: Kylas Overlay — Sales Intelligence
description: Surfaces curated Airtable company data and one-click meeting booking directly inside Kylas.

content_scripts._comment: Matched across all of Kylas, not just the detail paths. Kylas routes client-side, so a script matched to /details/* is never injected when a BD clicks in from a list — it only appears on a direct load. Each script watches the URL and shows itself on its own record type.
